programme.title: Med Nations 13 Albania
programme.desc: Along the Adriatic and Ionian coasts of Albania. From the charming streets of Vlora to sun-drenched beaches and historic towns, Albania reveals a vibrant blend of Mediterranean culture, history, and seaside traditions waiting to be discovered.

programme.title: il pane, le torte, la pizza
programme.desc: Accompany, contain, support: three key concepts defining Italy's iconic culinary creations—bread, cakes, and pizza. Bread, a fundamental staple, complements dishes while holding symbolic meaning. Savory pies, rooted in medieval tradition, have remained unchanged through centuries. Lastly, pizza, an ancient grain-based dish, achieved global fame after merging with tomatoes in Naples. Massimo Montanari leads us through this rich and flavorful journey.

programme.title: Monster Jam Fast Track
programme.desc: The Music City meltdown reaches a fever pitch as the Stadium Championship Series West storms into Nissan Stadium for an unforgettable showdown in Nashville. Elite drivers push their 12,000-pound machines to the absolute limit in a high-stakes gauntlet of head-to-head JCB Racing, technical Skills Challenges, and jaw-dropping Freestyle runs. From the legendary Grave Digger to the prehistoric power of Megalodon, every moment is packed with the raw energy and engine-roaring excitement that only Monster Jam can provide.

programme.title: Best of Monster Jam
programme.desc: Celebrate 25 years of The Crazy Bull with a high-octane compilation of El Toro Loco’s most legendary moments. This episode captures the sheer intensity of Freestyle competitions as fan-favorite drivers like Lucas Souza and Mark MacDonald push their machines to the ragged edge to chase down rivals like Bounty Hunter. Witness heart-stopping wow moments, including near-backflips, massive saves, and a dramatic spin cycle donut that leaves the track smoking. From mechanical failures like broken drive shafts to the pure adrenaline of bonus time, see why this 12,000-pound beast remains a world-class force in the stadium.

programme.title: Best of Monster Jam
programme.desc: Experience the absolute peak of monster truck mastery in this compilation of the best moments from January 2026. Fearless drivers push their 12,000-pound machines to the limit, featuring mind-bending stunts like Weston Anderson balancing his truck on a single BKT tire. The intensity reaches a fever pitch during Freestyle as competitors launch toward the Morgan and Morgan backflip ramp, including a spectacular backflip-to-double-save maneuver. From drivers tossing steering wheels out the window while mid-stunt to a dramatic cartwheel to save as time expires, this episode captures the high-energy atmosphere that only Monster Jam can deliver.

programme.title: Self Sentence
programme.desc: Sani, a financial auditor, promises his wife, halima, that he will allow her to work after they get married. He starts to make things difficult for her when he gets unnecessarily suspicious of halima, thinking that she is having an affair with her boss, mr. Patrick asuquo.

programme.title: First Love
programme.desc: A spouse's spending habits spark conflict, while a new neighbour adds unexpected drama to their lives. Tensions rise as secrets and past relationships resurface, testing the couple's bond.

programme.title: Drown to Tears
programme.desc: The warm embrace of a family becomes a cold rejection as their home shatters due to the passing of their only parent.

programme.title: Entangled
programme.desc: A once happy marriage starts to face crisis when the husband is promoted and starts having more responsibility at work, leaving his wife to believe he is now neglecting his family responsibilities.

programme.title: Vacation Gone Wrong
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. A young man goes on a vacation in the village and parties with the young women there. When he impregnates a village girl, he thinks he can go scot-free, but he soon finds out that Amaka is not just any girl and her connections to the law in the village makes it impossible for him to escape.

programme.title: African Man
programme.desc: Ken is finding it difficult to move on from his ex-wife so stops her from seeing their child when she decides to move on and find new love.

programme.title: The Right Girl
programme.desc: A young woman lies about her identity and hitches a free ride to Lagos. As they hit the road, Lisa realizes that her lies have only begun. Will she be able to disentangle herself from her deceit?

programme.title: A Mother's Heart
programme.desc: A man's love for his daughter is tested as another woman in his life comes in contest to that love.

programme.title: Getting A Yes
programme.desc: A loving daughter struggles to get the approval of her father for a suitor as he thinks no man is good enough for her.

programme.title: AMC Movie Talk S7 - Abayomi Alvin
programme.desc: Join us every week on the AMC couch as we talk to the biggest movers and shakers in the buzzing industry. We are putting you in the know with all things in African and Nollywood cinema actors, actresses, directors, producers, classic cinema and soon to be blockbuster hits it's all here on AMC Movie Talk.

programme.title: Indecent Affair
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. When a woman's controlling husband convinces her to pose as his cousin at a work event so his philandering boss can seduce her, the consequences are not only dire, but they also impose on everyone a journey of self discovery.

programme.title: The Drive
programme.desc: Becky and Chude are excited for their growing family, not realising just how much their unsavoury lifestyle will impact them.

programme.title: You And I S2 - Ep10
programme.desc: Ayo and Uzooma are back, navigating a new chapter of marriage where love, commitment and real-life challenges continue to put their relationship to the test.

programme.title: You And I S2 - Ep11
programme.desc: Ayo and Uzooma are back, navigating a new chapter of marriage where love, commitment and real-life challenges continue to put their relationship to the test.

programme.title: A Touch Of Fate
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Gerald, on the verge of marrying his boss's daughter and inheriting a car dealership, commits a hit-and-run after his bachelor party. When guilt drives him to inquire about the victim anonymously, he discovers he is being watched, leading to a complex web of secrets, guilt, and love.

programme.title: Lover's Nest
programme.desc: It is love at first sight when Kenny lays eyes on Mira, but she uses her career as an excuse not to commit to him. Will his persistence pay off or is there another reason Mira refuses to go out with him?

programme.title: Blue
programme.desc: Blue tells the poignant story of Somto and Ikenna coming to terms with the blows life has dealt them, the transforming power of sharing burdens, getting help from the strangest places and how they help each other heal.

programme.title: Unprecedented
programme.desc: Nadia and Simon start developing feelings for each other after Nadia is hired as a nurse for his wife, Theresa. Things get further complicated when their son, Raymond, comes home to visit and Theresa ends up dead.

programme.title: Rekindle
programme.desc: Kofi meets Iris, a beautiful woman during her vacation to Ghana and becomes infatuated with her, but she leaves him without leaving any information as to where she can be reached. When he goes to Nigeria to visit, he is surprised to be greeted by a familiar face claiming to be his cousin, Frank’s fiancé.

programme.title: Love Don't Cost A Thing
programme.desc: Ejike is such a stingy man that his cousin decides to scheme with her friend to try and get money from him. The scheme appears to be successful at first but feelings get involved and their plans start to fall apart.

programme.title: Love Found Me
programme.desc: The fate of a young woman in a toxic relationship changes after a chance meeting caused by car trouble.

programme.title: Love In Chaos
programme.desc: Charles begins to rethink his playboy ways when he finds love in an unexpected place.

programme.title: Rhythm And Love
programme.desc: Tensions between two tenants, a budding musician and a social media influencer, continues to rise as they try to find a way to co-exist in each other's space.

programme.title: The Newly Married
programme.desc: A young couple get married very quickly after they meet, but they soon find out that they should have taken more time to get to know each other before marriage as their differences causes them to constantly fight.

programme.title: AMC Music Lounge S7 - Dwin The Stoic
programme.desc: AMC Music Lounge returns for its seventh season bringing you some new interviews, new live performances, fun musical games, and many more from legendary and emerging artistes.

programme.title: Undoing Perfect
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Jude, Theresa and their beautiful daughter Uju seem like the perfect family, but Theresa has a dark secret which she does everything to protect. Everything changes when Uju falls ill and requires immediate blood transfusion. Jude gets the shock of his life as he realizes he is not Uju’s father. Undoing perfect is a contemporary story of love, trust, betrayal and hurt, a sincere story of love and marriage.

programme.desc: The new season of MTV Shuga Down South kicks off with Thuli living unhappily with her aunt in KwaZulu-Natal. After an attempted rape incident, Thuli decides to take control of her own life

programme.title: Van Veeteren - Tapaus G
programme.desc: Van Veeterenin ainoa selvittämättömäksi jäänyt tapaus näkee jälleen päivänvalon kun erään yksityisetsivän tytär tulee tapaamaan häntä. Väkivaltainen murhaaja, joka katosi vuosia sitten jäljettömiin, vaikuttaa palanneen uudella nimellä varustettuna - ja sekaantuneena uuteen murhaan.

programme.title: Bad Faith
programme.desc: Mona on juuri muuttanut kaupunkiin uuden työn perässä. Eräänä iltana kotimatkallaan hän todistaa raa'an murhan. Tapahtuma järkyttää ja pelästyttää häntä, mutta samalla jokin hänen sisällään herää eloon.

programme.title: On The Edge
programme.desc: Laittomat katuajot, alkoholi ja vauhdikkaat suhteet pitävät asiat mielenkiintoisina levottomille ja adrenaliinia janoaville kaveruksille. Yhdistelmä osoittautuu kuitenkin hengenvaaralliseksi, kun Nikolaj ja hänen paras ystävänsä Martin aiheuttavat nuoren tytön kuoleman katuajoissa.

programme.title: Kauas pilvet karkaavat
programme.desc: Kauas pilvet karkaavat kertoo helsinkiläispariskunnasta. Raitiovaununkuljettaja ja perinteikkään ravintola Dubrovnikin hovimestari menettävät työnsä, mutta eivät toivoaan Aki Kaurismäen (Le Havre) Suomi-trilogian ensimmäisessä osassa.

programme.title: Varjoja paratiisissa
programme.desc: Varjoja paratiisissa kertoo roskakuskin ja supermarketin kassan rakkaustarinan. Se kertoo ihmisistä kadun varjoisalla puolella, mutta myös itsekunnioituksesta ja rakkauden välttämättömyydestä.

programme.title: Ykköset Ja Nollat - Osa 1
programme.desc: Kriitikoiden ylistämä brutaali gangsteridraama Johan Renckiltä! FBI ja Interpol saavat vihiä suuresta luottokorttisotkusta, ja narkkari Sebbe napataan kiinni epäiltynä. Poliisin aloittaessa kuulustelun he saavat kuulla uskomattoman tarinan Göteborgin alamaailmasta.

programme.title: Call of the Unseen
programme.desc: Nuori taideopiskelija menettää uskonsa luoviin kykyihinsä. Oppilaan vanhahkoa opettajaa kiusaavat synkät mielikuvat, joita hänen kolkot maalauksensa herättävät. Heidän kohtalonsa kietoutuvat yhteen seikkailurikkaalla matkalla, jonka varrella he haluavat löytää itsensä.

programme.title: Mies vailla menneisyyttä
programme.desc: Mies vailla menneisyyttä kertoo muistinsa menettävästä miehestä, joka aloittaa elämänsä alusta yhteiskunnan köyhimpien keskellä. Mies vailla menneisyyttä sai Cannesin elokuvajuhlien Grand Prix -palkinnon ja Kati Outinen palkittiin roolisuorituksestaan parhaan naisnäyttelijän palkinnolla.

programme.title: Pidä huivista kiinni, Tatjana
programme.desc: Koskenkorvaa litkivä automekaanikko Reino (Matti Pellonpää) ja kahvista riippuvainen peräkamarin poika Valto (Mato Valtonen) lähtevät viettämään viikonloppua ja kohtaavat matkalla virolaisen Tatjanan (Kati Outinen) ja venäläisen Klavdian (Kirsi Tykkyläinen).

programme.title: On The Edge
programme.desc: Laittomat katuajot, alkoholi ja vauhdikkaat suhteet pitävät asiat mielenkiintoisina levottomille ja adrenaliinia janoaville kaveruksille. Yhdistelmä osoittautuu kuitenkin hengenvaaralliseksi, kun Nikolaj ja hänen paras ystävänsä Martin aiheuttavat nuoren tytön kuoleman katuajoissa.

programme.title: Tulitikkutehtaan tyttö
programme.desc: Äitinsä ja isäpuolensa kanssa asuva ja tulitikkutehtaan liukuhihnalla työskentelevä Iiris (Kati Outinen, Mies vailla menneisyyttä ja Le Havre) erehtyy luulemaan tanssiravintolassa kohtaamansa miehen kanssa viettämäänsä yötä rakkaudeksi. Väärinkäsityksellä on kohtalokkaat seuraukset.

programme.title: I Miss You
programme.desc: Identtiset kaksoset Cilla jaTina ovat hyvin läheiset mutta samalla valtavan erilaiset. Cilla on taiteilijasielu ja idealisti, joka kulkee omia teitään, kun taas Tina on suosittu, puberteettinen ja jatkuvasti rakastunut.

programme.title: Ariel
programme.desc: Ariel kertoo Taistosta (Turo Pajala, Hamlet liikemaailmassa), pohjoissuomalaisesta kaivosmiehestä. Kun kaivos suljetaan, Taisto kääntää Cadillacin keulan kohti etelää. Helsingissä Taisto asuu Pelastusarmeijan yömajassa, etsii työtä ja rakastuu uutteraan yksinhuoltajaäitiin.

programme.title: Viking Blood
programme.desc: Ryöstöretkellä ollessaan Tor-viikinki joutuu yllättäen keskelle vuosituhannen sotaa, jota käyvät vanhat ja uudet aasajumalat. Tor päättää, ettei yksikään heistä ansaitse voittoa ja valtaherruutta.

programme.title: Id:A
programme.desc: Hän ei tiedä, kuka hän on tai miten hän on päätynyt Ranskaan mukanaan kaksi miljoona euroa käteistä - ja ladattu ase. Mutta ilmiselvää on, että hän on hengenvaarassa. Hänen on otettava kaikki keinot käyttöön, mikäli hän mielii pysyä hengissä riittävän kauan selvittääkseen, kuka hän on.

programme.title: Akvaariorakkaus
programme.desc: Anna-Leena Härkösen menestysromaaniin perustuva elokuva itseään etsivästä Saarasta ja Jonista (Nicke Lignell), joka yrittää tehdä kaikkensa auttaakseen Saaraa, mutta tehtävä osoittautuu mahdottomaksi.

programme.title: Lindell - Orkesterimonttu - Osa 2
programme.desc: Elämänsä parhaan esityksen jälkeen oopperassa ensiviulisti Siv Ellen Blad murhataan julmasti. Rikoskomisario Cato Isaksen saa nopeasti selville, että hän oli joutunut postiryöstön kohteeksi. Piileekö siinä yhteys?

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Team Albert
programme.desc: Tee mitä haluat. Lukiolainen Albert ottaa hyvää tarkoittavan neuvon kirjaimellisesti. Yliopistoon meneminen lukion jälkeen ja sen jälkeen toimistotyön saaminen ei yksinkertaisesti ole se, miten hän kuvittelee tulevaisuutensa.

programme.title: Over The Edge
programme.desc: David ja Freja ovat mielettömän rakastuneita ja muuttavat unelmataloonsa Mønin saarelle. Pian idylli särkyy selittämättömän itsemurhan jälkeen. David päättää selvittää mysteerin, mutta mitä lähemmäs totuutta hän pääsee, sitä kauemmas hän etääntyy Frejasta.

programme.title: Horizon Line
programme.desc: Ex-pariskunta tapaa vuosien jälkeen osallistuessaan hyvän ystävänsä häihin. Heidän lentäessään trooppiselle saarelle valtameren yli pienellä, yksimoottorisella lentokoneella, pilotti saa kohtalokkaan sydänkohtauksen.

programme.title: Valehtelija
programme.desc: Valehtelija on kuvaus nuoresta huulenheittäjästä, joka ei koskaan puhu totta. Aki Kaurismäen esittämä nuori mies kuljeskelee pitkin Helsingin katuja ja koittaa lainata rahaa tutuilta ja tuntemattomilta, milloin milläkin verukkeella.

programme.title: Gourmet Club
programme.desc: Paavo Ylönen kuuluu yläluokkaiseen Gourmet Clubiin, johon jokainen jäsen tuo vuorollaan eksoottisen raaka-aineen. Se, joka tunnistaa mikä kätkeytyy gourmet-annokseen, voittaa suuren summan rahaa.

programme.title: Cha Cha Cha
programme.desc: Siltojen alla asusteleva alkoholisti Matti (Matti Pellonpää) on saamassa Amerikan tädiltään huomattavan perinnön, mutta miehen tulisi olla edustuskelpoinen tädin vierailun ajan. Matti kertoo tilanteesta autokauppiaana työskentelevälle ystävälleen, joka ehdottaa korvausta vastaan roolien vaihtoa.

programme.title: Original
programme.desc: Henry on elämän kalpea kopio. Nuori pankkivirkailija yrittää niin innokkaasti sopeutua muiden odotuksiin, että hän on jo kauan sitten kadottanut itsensä. Sitten Jon ilmestyy tyhjästä ja houkuttelee Henryn lähtemään mukaan Espanjaan avaamaan aidon bodegan.

programme.title: Münsterin juttu
programme.desc: Varakas viininmaahantuoja löydetään brutaalisti murhattuna voimakkaan iskun jälkeen päähän. Münster saa tapauksen tutkittavakseen.

programme.title: On The Edge
programme.desc: Laittomat katuajot, alkoholi ja vauhdikkaat suhteet pitävät asiat mielenkiintoisina levottomille ja adrenaliinia janoaville kaveruksille. Yhdistelmä osoittautuu kuitenkin hengenvaaralliseksi, kun Nikolaj ja hänen paras ystävänsä Martin aiheuttavat nuoren tytön kuoleman katuajoissa.

programme.title: John Hron
programme.desc: Länsi-Ruotsi, kesä 1995. Neo-natiivien väkivaltaisuudet horjuvat koko maassa. Elokuva on todellinen tarina 14-vuotiaasta kavereista Kungälvin pienestä yhteisökoodista.

programme.title: Jimmy Jones
programme.desc: Hyväsydäminen pikkurikollinen Jimmy Jones Malmöstä yrittää tienata rutkasti rahaa. Hän toimii välikätenä huumekaupassa, jota käyvät hollantilainen huumesyndikaatti ja Tukholmassa oleskeleva serbialainen pokerinpelaaja Dragan.

programme.title: Rebounce
programme.desc: Rebounce on tanskalainen draama teini-ikäisestä Louisesta, joka asuu isovanhempiensa luona, koska hänen äitinsä on vankilassa. Kun äiti yllättäen vapautuu, alkaa Louise salaa pitää yhteyttä äitiinsä ja ihannoida tätä sokeasti.

programme.title: Ykköset Ja Nollat - Osa 2
programme.desc: Kriitikoiden ylistämä brutaali gangsteridraama Johan Renckiltä! FBI ja Interpol saavat vihiä suuresta luottokorttisotkusta, ja narkkari Sebbe napataan kiinni epäiltynä. Poliisin aloittaessa kuulustelun he saavat kuulla uskomattoman tarinan Göteborgin alamaailmasta.

programme.title: In the Name of God
programme.desc: Elokuva Jumalanpalvelus kertoo Theodorista, joka on pappi pienessä kylässä, josta tulee puheenaihe siitä syystä, että hänen vaimonsa parani kuin ihmeen kautta tappavasta taudista Theodorin rukousten ansiosta.

programme.title: Van Veeteren: Pääsky, kissa, ruusu, kuolema
programme.desc: Van Veeteren –elokuvat perustuvat Håkan Nesserin menestysromaaneihin.

programme.desc: Nainen ryhtyy suhteeseen miehen kanssa, jota hän tuskin tuntee. Seksuaalisten seikkailujen myötä matkaan tulee mutkia. Eroottinen kulttielokuva Oscar-voittaja Kim Basingerin ja Oscar-ehdokas Mickey Rourken kanssa

programme.title: Personal Effects

programme.title: Varjoja paratiisissa

programme.title: Youth In Revolt
programme.desc: Nick rakastuu palavasti upeaan Sheeniin, mutta perhe, etäisyys ja exän vehkeilyt pitävät parin erossa. Ongelmat oikomaan Nick luo viekkaan, viiksekkään ja itsevarman sivupersoonan Francoisen, jonka ohjaksissa asiat kuitenkin mutkistuvat entisestään.

programme.title: Lumoava Kirous

programme.title: Maybe Baby

programme.title: Griffin And Phoenix

programme.title: The Sun Is Also A Star

programme.title: Kerrassaan vastustamaton

programme.title: Happily Ever After
programme.desc: After Jane finds her crying in a restaurant bathroom, Leela Penjore reveals that she is trying to avoid a pair of bodyguards sent to make sure she goes through with her marriage to Prince Sanjay of Bhutan. Though she convinces a judge to give her 24 hours to file a brief supporting her case, Jane is stunned when the State Department agrees to extradite Leela to be tried for sedition in Bhutan. Meanwhile, as Jane is surprised by Owen's disregard for the institution of marriage, Parker is called on to defend his son's elementary school teacher after he's suspended for appearing in a pornographic film. And after Teri helps drum up some business for Stacy by falsely claiming that the Pakery has some celebrity customers, she demands to be made President of Marketing. To keep Leela in the country, Jane gets the hearing transferred to the Bhutanese Consulate, which forces her to argue the case within that country's arcane judicial system. Even though Jane catches Prince Sanjay lying about Leela's trip to the United States, the Bhutanese judge ends the trial and orders her immediate deportation. However, with some help from an immigration court judge, Jane has the prince charged with human trafficking, giving Leela the asylum she's seeking. Meanwhile, after persuading a judge that teacher Greg Hillman's due process rights have been violated, Kim and Parker are given only a few hours to prepare before going to trial. And as Kim discovers that it was the principal who turned in Greg after seeing his X-rated videos, Teri's claims about the Pakery get some unwanted attention from the city. After forcing the principal to admit that he'd seen the videos several months before taking any action, Parker is jailed for contempt after stripping off his clothes in the courtroom in order to make the point that Greg shouldn't be punished for something he did legally years before becoming a teacher. And as Parker's principled stunt gets Greg reinstated, Stacy and Teri promise to cur

programme.title: Rigged
programme.desc: As Jane starts planning her wedding to Owen, Annie Maslin seeks her help after her husband Alan is killed in an offshore oil rig accident. While Jane is walking Annie through the story of Alan's death, representatives from Ivar Oil Company are also interviewing Kim about taking their case. But because she's the first to produce a signed retainer, Jane is given the go-ahead to represent Annie. Yet, despite Alan's documented concerns about the rig's safety and the accounts of the tragedy portraying him as a hero, Ivar's lawyer blames him for the accident. Meanwhile, as Jane worries when Owen doesn't call after going out of town to see a friend who he says was in a motorcycle accident, Teri gets her friend Liz hired as Kim's new assistant. And after learning that his son Eric is moving to Canada with his mother Elisa, Parker enlists Kim to help him sue for custody. Though engineer Tom Witten tells Jane and Annie that he agreed with Alan's concerns, he changes his story on the witness stand. While Jane struggles to find a witness who hasn't been paid to support the oil company, a sympathetic Ivar executive hints that there could also be problems with another rig, even though blueprints show that both were in compliance with all safety requirements. When Annie discovers she's pregnant, she asks Jane to accept Ivar's low-ball settlement offer. After Veronika's client Alison Thomas is arrested for child endangerment, Jane and Grayson agree to assist with her defense. programme.desc: Upon returning to work following Gina Blunt's arrest, Jane and Grayson are representing Kathy Kelton, who is suing her late fiancé Scott Richards' stepmother Caitlin over custody of his cremated remains. Though the case looks weak after Scott's sister testifies that Kathy is eating her fiancé's ashes, a sympathetic Grayson presses Jane to continue. Meanwhile, when Parker reveals that he secretly allowed the FBI to use the firm to nab Gina, Kim is angry over being kept in the dark about the sting. And as Jane starts to accept that Owen's sudden disappearance means that he's left her for another woman, she's surprised when he suddenly returns. When Kathy says that eating his ashes allows her to see Scott's ghost, Jane wonders if she would be better off getting psychological rather than legal help. But after Kathy collapses in the courtroom, she's found to be suffering from heavy metal poisoning. After tests indicate that Kathy was poisoned by a deadly chemical she ingested by eating Scott's remains, Grayson suspects that Caitlin used the substance to murder her stepson in order to inherit the $20 million he was about to receive from his father's estate. When he finally convinces Jane to listen to what he has to say, Owen explains his disappearance by revealing that he was getting checked out at the Mayo Clinic when he had a heart attack that left him in a coma for weeks. But while Jane wants to pick up where they left off, concerns about his health cause Owen to withdraw his marriage proposal. programme.title: Lady Parts
programme.desc: As Jane tries to avoid aggravating Owen's heart condition, Deb's mother Bobbie Dobkins is being sued for an injury sustained by her dance student, Kiera Walsh. As she's meeting with Kiera's mom Megan, Jane is unhappy to learn that Bobbie's insurance company has assigned the pushy and annoying lawyer Simon Grundy to represent its interests. Meanwhile, Grayson's high school classmate Fiona Krupp hires him when the city of Lakewood refuses to pay her for a sculpture it commissioned and now claims is obscene. And when Luke seeks her advice about buying concert tickets for a date, Stacy assumes they are for her. Once Kiera testifies that Bobbie made her do a dance move that resulted in what Megan says is a career-ending injury, both Jane and Simon ask Bobbie to consider settling. While Jane gets Megan to consider payment for Kiera's medical costs, Simon insists that she also withdraw the claim for loss of future earnings. So when Bobbie makes matters worse by saying that Kiera would have never made it as a professional dancer, Megan angrily refuses any offer. And when she vindictively amends the lawsuit to include emotional distress, Bobbie looks to strengthen her legal team by firing Jane and hiring Parker. Meanwhile, Grayson proves that Lakewood officials approved Fiona's sketches, and Judge Owen French orders the city to pay her for the finished piece. Although Megan settles with the insurance company for Kiera's medical bills, Bobbie still remains liable for the emotional damage claim. But when Jane finds that Kiera was actually injured while skateboarding before her dance lesson, not only does the jury decide in Bobbie's favor, but the insurance company fires Simon. When Teri organizes a demonstration in support of Fiona's artwork, Owen is inspired to rule that it cannot be altered by the city. And after Fiona admits that she always intended her sculpture to be provocative in order to gain notoriety for her work, she and Grayson start a romantic relationship.

programme.title: Family Matters
programme.desc: With the support of Councilman Mark Phillips, Jane files a lawsuit on behalf of Jenny Evans, a teenager who collapsed at a rave put on by promoter Dennis Fullman. After she receives a death threat against Owen meant to dissuade her from pursuing the case, Jane opts not to tell him for fear of aggravating his heart condition. However, once Owen learns that he's under police protection and insists Jane continue with the suit, things get tougher when Jenny's friend Carla admits that they took ecstasy before the rave. Meanwhile, when Owen hesitates to invite his father to their wedding, Jane asks Stacy to investigate. After donating his sperm to Carrie Renner, Dan Abraham hires Kim and Grayson when Carrie and her new fiancé Rick Keller insist that he relinquish his parental rights. Though Keller has Dan arrested for illegally trafficking in human tissue, the case is dropped after Kim demands that anyone who engaged in a privately arranged sperm donation also be prosecuted. And when Keller accuses Dan of violating a state law that prohibits gay men from being sperm donors, Kim's contention that the government has no business dictating how people choose to get pregnant prompts Carrie to leave her bullying fiancé and negotiate visitation rights for Dan. When Jenny dies, both her mother and Carla insist that Jane pursue her case. After an autopsy shows that Jenny died from dehydration and not a drug overdose, Jane and Owen discover that the water fountains in the Coliseum were turned off, leaving the 30,000 attendees to buy bottled water from a company owned by none other than Councilman Phillips. And once Jane finds proof that he's behind the threat against Owen, Phillips is arrested for Jenny's death. Finally, Owen admits that his reluctance over the invitation stems from his disapproval of his father's recent wedding. But as Owen reconciles with his dad, Jane resists telling him the truth about her identity.

When Brand shows up late for the first day of the trial, Jane is on her own after Vanden's lawyers reveal that Sheila had been taking a dangerous painkiller while she was pregnant. And after she can't find documents that Brand claims are in the case file, Jane worries about his mental state when he becomes disoriented during his courtroom presentation. Meanwhile, Jane hesitates to tell Stacy that she'll be moving out once she and Owen find a house. Enlisting Grayson's help when Jonah Pierce claims he owns the patent on the pake, Stacy realizes that the one person who can back up her story is her ex-business partner and con artist Nikki LePree. Finding her in jail under another name, Grayson offers to keep Nikki's identity a secret in exchange for photos that prove Stacy invented the pake. But when they fail to convince the judge, Stacy and Grayson challenge Jonah to a bake-off to establish who's telling the truth. Meanwhile, when Luke decides to advance his relationship with Kim, he's surprised when she suddenly claims that she doesn't want to see him anymore. Tracking down Brand's ex-wife, Jane learns that he has a degenerative brain condition known as Pick's disease. When confronted with the truth, Brand agrees to let Jane take the lead in the lawsuit, but not before falsely claiming he has proof that Vanden knew about the dangers of Aprox. So with Owen's encouragement, Jane makes it appear as though she actually has the study's results, forcing a Vanden executive to freeze up on the witness stand. And when the company agrees to settle, Brand credits Jane for salvaging the case before announcing that he is retiring. programme.title: Angels On Skates
programme.desc: The Angels don roller skates to investigate the disappearance of roller dance favorite, Rita Morgan. The motive, they suspect, is to prevent Rita and her dance partner Ken Satillo from winning the first place prize of $30,000 in the Fortune roller dance contest.

programme.title: Angels Go Truckin'
programme.desc: A million dollars in pharmaceuticals is hijacked from a cross-country truck. The Angels are called in to help the Venus Trucking Company that employs all women drivers.

programme.title: venging Angel
programme.desc: Frank Desmond, a heroin addict Kelly helped convict and send to prison, gets out of jail. Desmond proceeds with his friend, Eddie Feducci, to get Kelly in revenge. They dissolve a sleeping potion and then break into Kelly's house and inject heroin into the unconscious Angel.

programme.title: Angels At The Altar
programme.desc: Kelly is set to be maid of honor at best friend, Sharon Kellerman's, wedding. Suddenly they discover that there have been several near misses on the groom's life and the Angels are called in to investigate.

programme.title: Fallen Angel
programme.desc: The Angels are retained by opera star Carla Taggart to protect her Blue Heron Diamond from the ice cat jewel thief, Damien Roth. However, Jill Munroe (Farrah Fawcett) has become romantically involved with Roth, who invites her to participate in the heist.

programme.title: Caged Angel
programme.desc: When a young woman who is supposed to be in prison is found dead at the scene of a robbery, the Angels are called in to investigate. Kris enters the minimum-security prison population to determine how Amy Nalon was involved in the robbery of Kenyon Armored Security.

programme.title: Angels On The Street
programme.desc: The Angels go undercover as hookers to find the man that beat up the daughter of a dance school owner, Amy Hawkins. Kelly and Tiffany find Freddie The Pimp who hires the girls for his stable. He tries to intimidate them but they stand up to him.

programme.title: The Prince And The Angel
programme.desc: During a return visit to the States, Jill Munroe (Farrah Fawcett) becomes involved with a wealthy and eccentric European named Eric Railman. He has flair, expensive taste, and charisma. Eric invites Jill to his yacht but their interlude is interrupted by sniper fire.

programme.title: Angels On Skates
programme.desc: The Angels don roller skates to investigate the disappearance of roller dance favorite, Rita Morgan. The motive, they suspect, is to prevent Rita and her dance partner Ken Satillo from winning the first place prize of $30,000 in the Fortune roller dance contest.

programme.title: Angels Go Truckin'
programme.desc: A million dollars in pharmaceuticals is hijacked from a cross-country truck. The Angels are called in to help the Venus Trucking Company that employs all women drivers.

programme.title: Angels on Campus
programme.desc: When two girls from Tiffany's sorority disappear, the Angels find themselves back in college trying to unravel a suspected white slavery ring. English professor, James Fairgate, with a reputation as a womanizer, is considered a prime suspect.

programme.title: Angel Hunt
programme.desc: The Angels act upon a mysterious telephone call from Charlie to come to a Diablo Island in Mexico. When they are put ashore, Wilson, the boatman, inexplicably leaves, taking their baggage and weapons. The threesome is stranded on the beach Malcolm Case, onetime convict imprisoned on Charlie's testimony, phones Charlie himself, threatening to hunt and kill the Angels one at a time until their boss arrives and exchanges himself for them. Diablo Island, they learn, is a big game preserve and the Angels must be wary of wild animals as well as of gangsters. Tiffany is thought to be drowned after attacking Wilson. Kris and Kelly set snares hoping to trap the hunters. They are successful, killing one of the henchmen. Wilson recaptures Tiffany and leaves her tied in a shack where she is ultimately freed by Kris and Kelly. Case returns to chase the Angels but is killed unexpectedly by a big cat. Knowing they are in danger of seeing Charlie (for the first time)--Bosley sends him away quickly when he arrives for the exchange. They just miss crossing paths.

programme.title: Cruising Angels
programme.desc: Bosley and the Angels are set to transfer Charlie's 100-foot yacht, The Wayward Angel, to Miami -- only to find it stolen and mysteriously returned.

programme.title: Of Ghosts And Angels
programme.desc: While visiting Erica Renny Burke, Tiffany's old college friend, the Angels are alerted to mysterious and sinister occurrences in the Burke mansion.

programme.title: Angel's Child
programme.desc: While working on a robbery case, Kelly calls for police assistance when she observes the thieves escaping. A shootout occurs and one of the thieves, Joe Willow, escapes after killing a cop. Sgt. Cates takes his anger and frustration home where he batters his son, Greg. When Kelly realizes that Cates beats his son, she confronts the Sgt. and presses for child abuse charges. Joe Willow's underworld friends, Stone and Burke, observe the welfare court case awarding Kelly temporary custody of Greg while Cates works on the murder case. The thugs kidnap Kelly and Greg and attempt to persuade Cates to drop the search for Willow. Kelly manipulates her telephone answering service to alert the Angels and Cates to her house where she is being held captive. In the ensuing shootout, Kelly and Greg escape and the Angels apprehend the thugs and Willow. Cates admits his problem and is reunited with his son.

programme.title: One Of Our Angels Is Missing
programme.desc: Bondsman Harry Silvers hires the Angels to locate accused jewel thief Ray Devlin, who has fled, jumping bail. Using a cover as a wealthy divorcee, Kris is to lure Devlin from an Arizona resort back to Los Angeles.

programme.title: Catch A Falling Angel
programme.desc: Tennessean Seth Jeffers follows his girlfriend, Bess Murdock, to Los Angeles and discovers she is acting in porno movies. But when Seth disappears, the Angels are called to investigate. Kelly discovers a showbill with Bess' picture and the producer's name, Joe Willis. Kris approaches Willis and the Angels find and question Bess, who knows nothing about Seth's disappearance. Willis orders the Angels killed and they barely escape death in an auto accident. Kris steals a copy of Willis' movie and upon recognizing the locale, she has police comb the area for Jeffers' body. Bess overhears Willis tell his thugs how to handle police questions about Jeffers. She confronts him, but cannot escape Joe's plans to photograph her own death on film. Kris arrives in time to interrupt the shooting and following a brief shootout, the Angels arrive to apprehend the whole crew. A shaken Bess recuperates and returns home to Tennessee.

programme.title: Homes, Sweet Homes
programme.desc: When a wealthy Beverly Hills couple is robbed of valuable Egyptian art treasures, the Angels suspect the dapper real estate baron, Barry Kingsbrook. Kris infiltrates the Kingsbrook Agency as an agent and the Angels set up a phony house listing to lure Barry to Tiffany's supposed priceless collection of revolutionary period letters. Barry sets a deal with Bosley who poses as a wealthy collector willing to buy letters. Barry's assistant, Tina, tells him that Kris is a plant and while Tina shows Tiffany's house to prospective buyers (including the thieves) Barry takes Kris to his house where he attempts to drug her drink. The Angels capture the thieves and persuade Tina to tell where Kris is located. As the Angels arrive at Barry's house, they find that Kris has beaten Barry into confessing his role in previous thefts for money used to pay his enormous gambling debts.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Taking place over 2 days in Malaysia, this is part 1 of the world finals of Strongman Champions League!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League - we find out who is crowned as world champion today in the second part of the final epsiode

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Across seven rivers, through mountains and forests, 12 strongmen go to toughest places to find out who is strongest Viking in the World and open a new season of Strongman champions league for 2015. Events like the Hercules Hold, Yoke Race and pulling a real Viking ship are some of the ingredients of this fantastic show.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The second stage of Strongman champions league will be hosted in Germany, by FIBO - the leading international trade show for fitness, wellness and health worldwide with 300,000 visitors in four days. Special implements like the biggest log in the world or the special Bavarian stone lift are not only a challenge, but also an opportunity for new personal, national and world records.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Holland is hosting 12 different countries with 14 of the strongest men in the world for the third stage of the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Zydrunas Savickas, one of strongest people on earth is in this competition which has attracted the attention of the audience in the battle for the title of strongest man in Finland. The next round of SCL is in Bulgaria.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stage of the competition is in Bulgaria where Ervin Katona (SCL World Champion 2012) will compete for the last time.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Krzysztof Radzikowski, the leader in the league will fight hard to keep Dainis Zageris off from the title and to gather another 25 ranking points in this next stage in Latvia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The competition sees a close battle with a new world record in overhead dumbbell and close finishes throughout the day. This stage is in Croatia, in a city over 1700 years old, steeped in Roman tradition and history, the athletes arrive for the truck pull after a picturesque boat ride on the Adriatic Sea.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are now half way through the SCL 2015 and getting closer to the grand world finals in Turkey. The eighth stage is in Poland, the home country of the current leader Krzysztof Radzikowski.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage we go into the mountains of Austria to find out through six grueling events who is the strongest in the land of Alps. Martin Wildauer, current World Champion 2014 and Austrian local is competing alongside Zageris, Radzikowski, Belsak and many others.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The 10th stage of this year's competition in Strongman Champions League is held in the Romanian city of Sibiu where the 12 strongmen continue to compete for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The 11th stage is the SCL Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. In this championship, each competitor must lift three different weights overhead. Zydrunas Savickas is the current world record holder in the Log Lift.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This next episode of the Strongman Champions League is hosted in Lithuania and sees us getting one step closer to the final.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The 13th stage of Strongman Champions League is in Maia, Portugal. The competition is at the “Powerexpo” – one of the best sport and fitness events in Portugal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This stage is in Martinique and eight strongmen from all over the world will compete for the last chance to gather points before the world grand finals in December.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A special World championship under the newcomers and lightweights in the Strongman world. Some of them will step from this to the heavyweights divisions.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 15 outstanding competitions all over the world, finally we are here at the final competition of this year’s Strongman Champions League hosted in Turkey.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the land of Vikings - Norway - to the first stage of the SCL World Series 2016

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Stage 10 of the Strongman Champions League 2025 arrives in Gdańsk, Poland, where a world-class lineup competes in tough events including deadlift, log lift, and loading race. With top athletes like Aivars Smaukstelis and Adam Roszkowski in action, the battle intensifies as the season nears its climax.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The second stage of the SCL heads to the FIBO convention, Cologne. The leading international trade show for fitness, wellness and health hosts.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the third stage of SCL world series 2016, the athletes compete in Kaunas for the SCL Log Lift World Championships.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage four is an epic competition and a few surprises. With 14 strongmen from all over the world, one newcomer left quite an impression.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This year Lauri Nami joins the starting list, back after last year's injury in Romania

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL train stopped in Zlatibor for the stage 6 of the MLO SCL. 11 compete for the title in the home country of legendary Ervin Katona.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Bulgaria hosts the next stage of the SCL. Current leader in the World Series is Matjaz Belsak, youngest competitor and strongest man of Slovenia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The competitors battle it out in the special event, the Atlas Steel Stone. This stone is made completely from iron and cannot be touched with any support.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This stage sees the strongmen visit Vaasa, Finland. Residents here are familiar with the competition because some of the SCL icons are from their country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: 38 athletes compete in the under 90kg and under 105kg SCL World Championships. From each weight class, the top 12 qualify for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A two day, seven event battle with lots of spectators.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Alex Moonen is leading. Part two of the competition in Romania showcases a new challenge - Hercules Hold.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage in Curacao no one wants to lose the chance to fight for one kilo gold in World grand finals in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The last chance to qualify for the World Grand Finale. Zageris and Belsak fight for the better position for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We reach Dubai where we will crown the new champion for SCL 2016. This is part one of the world finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this last episode, the best athletes compete in Pole Push, Deadlift, Forward Hold and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in beautiful Norway for the kick off of the 2017 MLO Strongman Champions League season. With partly cloudy weather and lots of snow, we have the perfect scenery for the athletes, who prepare for the first contest of the year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A definite highlight in this FIBO edition in Germany, Strongman Champions League introduced its new rules for a special team item. Graham Hicks tries here to set a New World Record on the biggest log in the world, currently held by Krzysztof Radzikowski. Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Siófok, Hungary, by Lake Balaton for a crucial late-season showdown. Reigning champion Adam Roszkowski returns to defend his title against a stacked field, including Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana. With World Finals approaching, the battle for points intensifies.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: It’s the final day of the Strongman Champions League’s first-ever U.S. event in Sandusky, Ohio. Athletes face a massive gas tanker truck pull, a unique shovel deadlift, and Atlas Stones weighing 120–200 kg - plus a thrilling Guinness World Record attempt. Who will claim the SCL USA crown?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Dubai for its penultimate stage before the World Finals. Elite athletes battle across gruelling events, including the dumbbell press, deadlift, and bag toss. With fierce competition and rankings on the line, every point counts in the race to qualify for South Africa.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League continues in Dubai for the final stage before the World Finals. Twelve elite athletes battle gruelling events near the Burj Khalifa, with Ramin Farajnejad leading after three rounds. With fierce competition and last chances to qualify, the stakes couldn’t be higher.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals begin in Uppington, South Africa, after a global season of elite competition. Top athletes gather for a dramatic showdown, led by reigning champion and hometown hero Rayno Nel, as they battle in extreme events for the ultimate strongman title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals continue in Uppington, South Africa. With three wins already, hometown hero and World’s Strongest Man Rayno Nel leads the competition, backed by a passionate crowd. As athletes battle by the Orange River, the fight for the title and $50,000 intensifies.

programme.title: The Darkest Hour
programme.desc: Toiminnantäyteisessä sci-fi -trillerissä ryhmä nuoria amerikkalaisia on vierailulla Moskovassa, kun muukalaislaji hyökkää kaupunkiin ja syöksee heidät keskelle epätoivoista selviytymistaistelua.

programme.title: Bulletproof Monk
programme.desc: Vuosikausien ajan nimetön munkki on puolustanut ja suojellut muinaista kääröä – Äärettömän Voiman Kääröä – joka sisältää avaimen mittaamattomaan voimaan. Nyt munkin täytyy löytää suojatti; seuraava suojelija salaisuudelle.

programme.title: The Last Witch Hunter
programme.desc: Monet ovat jahdanneet noitia vuosisatojen ajan eri puolilla maailmaa. Yksi heistä on urhea soturi Kaulder, joka onnistui tappamaan vahvan Kuningatarnoidan ja tuhoamaan samalla tämän joukot...

programme.title: On The Edge
programme.desc: Laittomat katuajot, alkoholi ja vauhdikkaat suhteet pitävät asiat mielenkiintoisina levottomille ja adrenaliinia janoaville kaveruksille. Yhdistelmä osoittautuu kuitenkin hengenvaaralliseksi, kun Nikolaj ja hänen paras ystävänsä Martin aiheuttavat nuoren tytön kuoleman katuajoissa.

programme.title: Hamekyttä 2
programme.desc: Hamekytän villissä jatko-osassa Martin Lawrence ja Nia Long palaavatviihdyttämään koko perhettä. Kansakunnan turvallisuus on uhattuna ja FBI-agenttiMalcolm Turner in on jälleen kerran...

programme.title: Turpiin vaan ja onnea
programme.desc: Tavanomaista Spencer - Hill -mättöä. Matt Kirby ja Wilbur Walsh (Hill And Spencer) ovat hieman aggressiivisia luonteita ja joutuvatkin usein vaikeuksiin, joista kuitenkin yleensä selviytyvät nyrkkiensä avulla.

programme.title: Banaanipojat hula-hula saarella
programme.desc: Huoletonta elämää viettävä onnenonkija Alan saa käsiinsä aarrekartan, josta selviää japanilaisten sotajoukkojen toisen maailmansodan aikana kätkemän rahasaaliin sijainti.

programme.title: The Shanghai Job
programme.desc: Loppuunpalaneen yksityisen turva-agentin on määrä kuljettaa arvokas kiinalainen antiikkiesine ulos Shanghaista, mutta matkan varrelle tulee vastoinkäymisiä.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3
programme.desc: Eletään 1600-luvun alkua feodaaliajan Japanissa, ja ratsain kulkeva mies jää vangiksi taistelussaan samurairyhmää vastaan. Vajaat 400 vuotta myöhemmin toimittaja April O’Neil hankkii kirpputorilta lahjoja kilpikonnaystävilleen.

programme.title: Renegades
programme.desc: Renegades kertoo Yhdysvaltain laivaston erikoisjoukosta, joka on komennuksella sodan riivaamassa Itä-Euroopassa.

programme.title: Meidän gangstereiden kesken
programme.desc: Painija Charlie ja jäätelönmyyjä Sonny ovat huolettomia ja mukavia kavereita, jotka pysyttelevät poissa vaikeuksista. Mutta kun kaupungin ja alamaailman johtaja erehtyy luulemaan heitä pahamaineiseksi tappajakaksikoksi, kaikki muuttuu...

programme.title: The Cold Light Of Day
programme.desc: Nuori liikemies Will Shaw on ansaitulla lomalla vanhempiensa kanssa. Välimerellistä idylliä ei kuitenkaan kestä kauan, kun Willin perhe katoaa: mystistä salkkua jahtaavat agentit sieppaavat muun perheen.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Luc Bessonin toimintaelokuvan pääosassa upea Zoe Saldana (Avatar) pukeutuu koston mustaan raivatessaan tieltään vanhempiensa tappajat.COLOMBIANA on toiminnantäyteinen tarina nuoresta tytöstä, joka joutuu raakuuksien ja koston maailmaan.

programme.title: Hannu ja kerttu: noitajahti
programme.desc: 15 vuotta piparkakkutalotapauksen jälkeen Hannusta ja Kertusta on kehittynyt palkkionmetsästäjiä, jotka jahtaavat noitia.

programme.title: Viking Blood
programme.desc: Ryöstöretkellä ollessaan Tor-viikinki joutuu yllättäen keskelle vuosituhannen sotaa, jota käyvät vanhat ja uudet aasajumalat. Tor päättää, ettei yksikään heistä ansaitse voittoa ja valtaherruutta.

programme.title: TMNT
programme.desc: Splinter; rotta sensei; aistii, että hänen neljä teini-ikäistä kilpikonnaopettajaansa ovat eronneet ja heidän on luotava side voittaakseen muinaisen hirviön.

programme.title: Ben-Hur
programme.desc: Lew Wallacen eeppinen romaani lunastuksesta on tämän innostavan sovituksen sydämessä. Syytetty aatelismies (Jack Huston) selviää vuosien orjuudesta kostaakseen hänet pettäneelle ystävälleen (Toby Kebbell). Elokuvassa nähdään myös Morgan Freeman.

programme.title: Max Steel
programme.desc: Suosittuun Mattel-lelusarjaan ja tv-sarjaan perustuen Max Steel on teini-ikäinen uuden sukupolven supersankari, ja elokuvassa toiminta, komedia ja modernit erikoistehosteet muodostavat eeppisen koko perheen seikkailun.

programme.title: Vampire Academy
programme.desc: Lissa ja Rose ovat 17-vuotiaita tyttöjä, jotka käyvät lukiota monien muiden 17-vuotiaiden tapaan. He eroavat muista siten, että Lissa juo verta ja heidän lukionsa on salainen sisäoppilaitos rauhantahtoisille Moroi-vampyyreille ja heidän suojelijoilleen!

programme.title: Gods Of Egypt
programme.desc: Tässä muinaisen Egyptin mytologiasta ammentavassa toimintaseikkailussa koko ihmiskunnan tulevaisuus on vaakalaudalla, kun tavallinen kuolevainen Bek nousee sankariksi ryhtyessään pelastamaan maailmaa ja tosirakkauttaan.

programme.title: Taxi 4
programme.desc: Pahanilmanlintu Émilienillä Marseillen rikospoliisista on huostassaan yksi Euroopan etsityimmistä miehistä.

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Ahkera lukiolainen Vee Delmonico on kyllästynyt olemaan varjossa. Kun kaverit painostavat osallistumaan suosittuun nettipeliin, Nerveen, Vee päättää osallistua yhteen kisaan harmitonta hupia.

programme.title: Aika ei anna armoa
programme.desc: Denzel Washington on pääosassa tässä mukaansatempaavassa trillerissä. Hän esittää pikkukaupungin poliisipäällikköä, joka joutuu myrskyn silmään tutkiessaan salaa tapailemansa naisen murhaa… koska kaikki todisteet viittaavat häneen!

programme.title: Horizon Line
programme.desc: Ex-pariskunta tapaa vuosien jälkeen osallistuessaan hyvän ystävänsä häihin. Heidän lentäessään trooppiselle saarelle valtameren yli pienellä, yksimoottorisella lentokoneella, pilotti saa kohtalokkaan sydänkohtauksen.

programme.title: The Perfect Weapon
programme.desc: Lähitulevaisuus. Condor (Johnny Messner) toimii tiukkaa kuria pitävän Valtion ja sitä diktaattorin ottein ohjailevan Johtajan (Steven Seagal) mitään kyselemättömänä palkkamurhaajana.

programme.title: Tracker
programme.desc: Vuoteen 1903 sijoittuva ihmisjahtidraama Jäljittäjä alkaa kun Arjan (Ray Winstone), Etelä-Afrikan buurisodista selviytynyt sissi, saapuu Uuden-Seelannin siirtokuntaan ja hänelle luvataan palkkio Kereaman (Temuera Morrison), sotilaan tappamisesta syytetyn maori merimiehen, kiinniottamisesta.

programme.title: Prey
programme.desc: Nuorenparin täytyy paeta lähetyssaarnaaja-asemaltaan Kalaharin autiomaassa, kun sotilaallinen äärijärjestö uhkaa heitä. Mutta kun heidän koneensa tippuu villieläinten suojelualueelle, heidän täytyy taistella henkensä edestä.

programme.title: Safe
programme.desc: He tappoivat hänen ystävänsä ja vaimonsa. He uhkasivat tappaa kaikki hänen tulevat tuttavansa. Kun vapaaottelija Luke Wright itsemurhan partaalla näkee samojen venäläisten mafiatyyppien jahtaavan 12-vuotiasta kiinalaista tyttöä, hänellä naksahtaa.

programme.title: Reunalla
programme.desc: Uskallatko ottaa seuraavan askeleen? Vankikarkuri Nick Cassidy ilmestyy yhtäkkiä pilvenpiirtäjän reunukselle New Yorkissa. Aikooko hän hypätä?
